text:
elaine: Dropping PR #520 for the relnotes + changelog for the small feature rollout. Main asks: 1) confirm SDK snippets (Java + Rust) compile, 2) short migration note for pinned models, 3) ensure public-friendly phrasing for rollback policy. Pls review before EOD.

pete: skimmed. Java snippet uses Builder pattern but misses `import java.time.Duration;` which causes the sample to fail. I'll push a one-line fix.

omar: I added a Rust snippet variant. Note: our current rust crate name changed from `redwood_inference` to `redwood`. Updated example accordingly.

elaine: Nice. Keep Rust example minimal. We want copy-paste runnable examples in the relnotes (not full apps).

localize-bot: Localization check: flagged term "graceful degrade" in the rollback paragraph. Suggest change to "fallback behavior" for translatability. Also flagged a long sentence in French translation file.

pete: I fixed the Java import and replaced "graceful degrade" with "fallback behavior". Pushed to branch.

omar: One content question: changelog bullet references "adaptive batching improvements" 1; should we say "available via batching.policy=adaptive" or simply "adaptive batching"? The legal/marketing team prefers concise phrasing.

elaine: Use concise: "Adaptive batching available via batching.policy=adaptive". We'll expand in the migration guide. Keep relnotes short.

ci-bot: Running docs-snippet-test and linkcheck on refs/heads/release/relnotes-520.

ci-bot: docs-snippet-test: Java example failed (missing import) -> fixed by pete. Rust example: warning about unused mut; non-blocking.

ci-bot: linkcheck: found 1 external link returning 404 (third-party tutorial).

elaine: For the 404, can we replace with an official spec link or a stable archived URL? We shouldn't point to flaky blogs.

pete: Replaced with spec link (https://spec.example.org/model-pinning). Pushed.

localize-bot: Re-run l10n checks requested.

localize-bot: l10n: French OK after wording change; German: phrase "pinning semantics" flagged for clarification, suggest short parenthetical: "(behavior when a specific model version is unavailable)".

omar: I'll add that parenthetical as a short inline note in the migration guide.

elaine: Two additional asks before we merge: 1) Add a tiny "How to test" CLI example for the smoke test; 2) Add a one-sentence "Known issues" item about embeddings stream edge-case (public-friendly).

pete: CLI smoke test suggestion: `redwoodctl smoke --scenario=short-chat --timeout=20s` with expected `status=ok` in JSON. I'll leave it in PR comments.

omar: For known issues blurb: "On some quantized models, embedding streaming may truncate at token boundaries; workaround: use streaming.legacy_fallback or the non-quantized model variant." Keep it short.

elaine: Good. Final: rollout window is July 12-13 UTC, with a staged canary for 5% of traffic. Add the rollback sentence: "If regression metric X rises above threshold, we will revert to prior deploy tag." Avoid internal metric names.

ci-bot: Final run: docs-snippet-test: all snippets pass (warnings cleared). linkcheck: all links 200. l10n re-check: passed.

elaine: Perfect. I'll do an editorial pass tomorrow morning and merge post-green. If anything else shows up, comment on PR #520. Thanks! :rocket:
